column1: # *** THE WHOLE FAMILY, FROM THE ONE INDEX THAT NAMES THE MOTHER. 8 October 2026. ***
# David logged this session in to gro.gov.uk and the search row 128 named in September was run.
# *** WHY THIS INDEX AND NOT FREEBMD: *** the GRO's own online index prints the *** MOTHER'S MAIDEN
# SURNAME *** on every birth from 1837. FreeBMD does not and never will. So a search on
# *** surname TAYLOR + mother's maiden surname BRAYLEY *** returns the children of William Taylor and
# Mary Ann Hellen Brayley *** BY DEFINITION, with no inference and no candidate-weighing. ***
# *** SEARCHES RUN (sex is a mandatory field, so each window was run twice): ***
# *** AND THE CRITICAL WINDOW WAS RE-RUN ON "SIMILAR SOUNDING VARIATIONS" *** because this archive has
# documented BRAILEY as a spelling of this name. That returned 28 births across England - Barlow,
# Barrell, Burrell, Brealey, Bearley - and *** exactly the same two at Bideford. ***

column6: *** THE TWINS, PROVED BY THE PAGE. *** Hers is page 490 and William John's is 489 - consecutive entries in one quarter.
See above. The archive read them as twins from a tree and then from the 1871 census; this is the registration itself.
The second daughter - and the *** "EDIE" *** of 1935, established the same day from four other files.
*** THE GRO PRINTS "WALKER" IN FULL. *** The 1891 census transcription read "Margaret H. N."; the FreeBMD index abbreviated it to "W". It is Walker, her great-great-grandmother's surname.
*** AND SHE IS ALONE. *** No second birth of 1879 to this mother, of either sex. See the note below on the twin who never existed.
The last child before the gap the whole Edith argument lived in.
*** THE EIGHTH CHILD AND THE SIXTH DAUGHTER. *** Born 17 September 1884, baptised at Northam 30 October 1884.
Born 3 August 1889 at 2 Fore Street. *** And nothing is registered to this mother after her ***, in either sex, to 1893.
